# Memory_Capacity_Maximization

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
The optimization objective that quantifies how well a reservoir can retain and reconstruct past input signals, used as a fitness metric for topology selection. Directly links network structure to computational capability, guiding design of neuromorphic reservoirs for temporal processing tasks.
